mentions.name: Hall effect analog arcade joystick
mentions.description: This is an arcade joystick with full analog capability built around a Hall effect sensor. It uses an RP2350 microcontroller, provides inputs for 16 buttons, and outputs RGB LEDs for every button. It is designed as a direct swap for any enclosure designed for a modern Sanwa stick, on which it is based.
mentions.problem: Existing commercial analog arcade joysticks, such as the Ultimarc Ultrastik the author currently uses, have many shortcomings.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on an arcade joystick with full analog capability using a Hall effect sensor. It's along the lines of the Ultimarc Ultrastik, which I'm currently using, but it has so many shortcomings that I decided to build my own. I decided to go with a rp2350 microcontroller, and it will have inputs for 16 buttons, and outputs for RGB leds for every button. It should be a direct swap for any enclosure designed for a modern Sanwa stick, which it's based on.
mentions.author: platevoltage
